coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Counting individual dataset names, model names, conditions, attacks, and remaining variable specifications gives 11 matches out of 17 ground-truth items (65%). Matches include AdvBench, three target models, both SSP conditions, AutoDAN and PAIR, a fixed PAIR search budget, and string-based and GPT-based success assessment.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design omits MaliciousInstruct, the constant JailTrickBench framework, Vicuna-7B, and Qwen1.5-7B. It does not specify AutoDAN suffix lengths of 10–100 tokens or averaging over 3–5 runs. It combines the evaluation methods into an ensemble rather than clearly reporting separate ASRPrefix and ASRAgent metrics. It also introduces unsupported datasets, attacks, adaptivity conditions, and utility metrics.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports that SSP substantially lowers attack success rates, nor any of the model-specific AutoDAN and PAIR reductions.
